title: Draw calls in, bytes out
description: Both ways in rasterize into one surface, through the same recognizers and the same blending, so identical geometry gives identical bytes.

nodes.title: Draw calls
nodes.detail: Frame::clear, fill_rect, textured_rect and mesh, each rasterized the moment you make it.

nodes.title: The rasterizer
nodes.detail: Rectangles, one-color fans and triangles with one texel draw as spans. Everything else is covered pixel by pixel. NEON on AArch64, the same bytes either way.

nodes.title: SoftwareSurface
nodes.detail: width x height x 4 bytes of premultiplied RGBA8, top row first. Yours to copy to a framebuffer, a file or a hash.

nodes.title: An egui UI
nodes.detail: With the egui feature, render_egui runs your UI closure, applies egui's texture uploads and tessellates at one pixel per point.

nodes.title: Textures
nodes.detail: Premultiplied RGBA8, created and freed through the renderer. egui's font atlas lives in the same store, under the same 8 MiB budget.
